1.o: The first episode focuses on humpback whales and blue whales - exploring the intimate details of the largest animals that have ever lived on our planet- the great whales.

2.o: This episode looks at the cognitive abilities of dolphins. We have long wondered if the universe harbours other intelligent life, but perhaps we should be looking at our own oceans. Dolphins have large brains, and are quick to learn new tricks. Like children, they also enjoy playing games.

3.o: This final episode looks at the vocalization of whales and dolphins, and how they communicate with each other.

1.o: In the aftermath of the Battle of Sekigahara, warrior Shimazu Toyohisa is suddenly thrust into a mysterious world where he is shocked to encounter the supposedly Oda Nobunaga and the historical figure Nasu Suketaka Yoichi.

3.t: Army of Ours: Sortie at Dawn

11.t: The Adventure of the Pistol Daimyo: Bullet Counting Song
11.o: The coup begins yet right from the start there is an unexpected wrench thrown into the plans. The roar of muskets now rips across the new world, and the Drifters find their places leading armies.

12.t: Staring at Shinsengumi: The Song of the Fervid Kyushu Man

1.o: Shungo meets Mayu at his school, and learns about Mayu's condition.

2.t: A Relationship Due To Willful Negligence
2.o: يدعو "دو كيونغ" "هاي يونغ" لشراب ليشكرها على العثور على محفظته. وعندما تنسى "هاي يونغ" هاتفها، يُحضره "دو كيونغ" إليها في اليوم التالي.

3.t: Love If You Want To Live
3.o: تنتقل "هاي يونغ" إلى شقتها الخاصة لتكتشف أن "دو كيونغ" يعيش في الغرفة المقابلة. ويحثها "دو كيونغ" الذي يشعر بالدهشة والانزعاج، على المغادرة.

4.t: Let's Buy A Humming Tune And Go Home
4.o: ترى "هاي يونغ" "هاي يونغ" الأخرى تعدو في سباق ماراثون. وعندما يسمع "دو كيونغ" هذا، يشعر بالحيرة لأن رؤيته قد أصبحت حقيقة واقعة.

5.o: تسقط وسادة حمالة صدر "هاي يونغ" عند معانقتها "دو كيونغ". وبعد شعوره بالتحسن، يدعو "دو كيونغ" "هاي يونغ" للعشاء فيصادف "هاي يونغ" الأخرى.

6.o: يشاهد "دو كيونغ" رؤية لـ"هاي يونغ" وهي تكسر نافذة زجاجية، وتجد والدة "هاي يونغ" "دو كيونغ" فجأة في غرفة ابنتها. ماذا عساه أن يفعل؟

7.t: I Wish I Was The Only Woman In The World
7.o: تعطي "هاي يونغ" "دو كيونغ" وجبة غداء أعدّتها مع والديها. ويشعر الموظفون الآخرون في مكتب "دو كيونغ" بالدهشة من المذاق الرائع للطعام.

8.t: I'm Crying Not Because Of Him, But Because Of You
8.o: يرى "دو كيونغ" "هاي يونغ" الأخرى والتي تقترح أن يمنحا علاقتهما بداية جديدة. وفي الوقت نفسه، يظهر "تي جين" فجأة أمام "هاي يونغ".

9.t: The Wind Blew In His Heart
9.o: يشاهد "دو كيونغ" رؤية مذهلة يُقبّل فيها "هاي يونغ". وفي هذه الأثناء، تكتشف "هاي يونغ" في العمل أنها أكبر من "هاي يونغ" الأخرى.

10.o: ينتهي الأمر عقب مشاجرة بتقبيل "دو كيونغ" "هاي يونغ"، لكن عندما لا يتصل بها في وقت لاحق، تردّ "هاي يونغ" قليلة الصبر على اتصال "تي جين".

11.o: أثناء رحلتهما في السيارة إلى "سيول"، يقرر "دو كيونغ" التقرب أكثر من "هاي يونغ". في هذه الأثناء، يزور "تي جين" والدي "هاي يونغ" للاعتذار.

12.t: Wish You Misery Once You Leave Me
12.o: تتصل "هاي يونغ" وهي في حالة سُكر بمحطة إذاعية عندما علمت بسلوك "دو كيونغ" السئ، وتذكر عن غير قصد اسمها الحقيقي على الهواء.

13.o: بعد نزهة مع صديقة لها، تعود "هاي يونغ" إلى المنزل مبتلّة جدًا وعازمة على نسيان ماضيها. ويزورها "دو كيونغ" فجأة ودون سابق إنذار.

14.t: Silence All The Other Sounds That Are Not Of Love
14.o: يعود كل من "دو كيونغ" و"هاي يونغ" لبعضهما البعض. ويسعد الطبيب بسماع ذلك، حيث يُخبر "دو كيونغ" أنّ مستقبله قد تغيّر.

15.t: Those Past Days I Couldn't Give You More, More Love
15.o: تتعمق علاقة "دو كيونغ" و"هاي يونغ" أكثر. وعندما تراود "دو كيونغ" رؤية تتضمن صوت "هاي يونغ"، فإنه يشعر أنّ مستقبله يتغير.

16.o: في رؤية جديدة يشاهد "دو كيونغ" سيارة "تي جين" تكاد تصدمه. ويتم تشجيعه على عدم الاستسلام، لذلك يُحضر الزهور إلى مكتب "هاي يونغ".

17.t: I Could Die Today With No Regrets
17.o: يؤكد "دو كيونغ" و"هاي يونغ" حبهما لبعضهما. وفي وقت لاحق، يذهب "جين سانغ" إلى "الساونا" مع "دو كيونغ" ويتحدّث عن مشاعره تجاه "سو كيونغ".

18.t: Please Stay Alive, I'm Grateful You're Alive, Honey
18.o: يعترف "دو كيونغ" بكل شيء لـ"هاي يونغ" ويذهبان لرؤية طبيبه، بينما تخبر "هاي يونغ" والديها أنها تريد أن تعيش معه.

1.o: The valley is the product of deep-seated geological forces which have spewed out a line of cloud-wreathed volcanoes stretching from Ethiopia to Tanzania. Their peaks provide a refuge for East Africa's most extraordinary wildlife, including newly discovered and previously unfilmed species which have evolved surprising survival strategies to cope with their challenging mountain environment.

2.o:
The Great Rift Valley channels a huge diversity of waterways - rivers, lakes, waterfalls, caustic springs and coral seas - spanning from Egypt to Mozambique.

Some lake and ocean deeps harbor previously unseen life-forms, while caustic waters challenge life to the extreme. But where volcanic minerals enrich the Great Rift's waterways, they provide the most spectacular concentrations of birds, mammals and fish in all Africa.

3.o: The Great Rift Valley provides the stage for an epic battle between trees and grass - its course influenced by volcanic eruptions, landscape and rainfall. On its outcome rests the fate of Africa's great game herds. In the Rift's savannas, grazers and their predators struggle to outwit each other, forcing one group of primates to develop a social system that paved the way for the evolution of mankind.

3.o: Martin poses as an international arms dealer to rescue kidnapped chemist Richard Hubbard and track the sale of VX gas. Before long, he connects with a beautiful arms trader and slips into a shadowy romance with her.

4.o: Martin is sold VX gas, resulting in the apprehension of the Colonel and Ana Paulanos. In response, one of the Colonel's minions releases VX on a crowded bus, and promises more attacks if the Colonel and Ana aren't released.

5.o: Martin is put on leave in the wake of a confrontation with the Colonel. Martin then begins to investigate his own past, discovering that an enigmatic smuggler in Houston may have the answers he needs.

6.o: Fallout from a shoot-out finds Martin taking Kyle Dobson into custody. Before long, Dobson's mysterious employers enlist hit men to retrieve a wounded Dobson, prompting Martin to plan a desperate escape with Dobson back to Los Angeles.

7.o: Martin returns to DCO after the events in Houston and is presented with the case of a threat to assassinate a visiting Saudi Prince. The investigation leads Martin and Rice to a beautiful and charismatic female rights activist.

8.o: Martin stays in legend as journalist Sebastian Egan to exonerate Hani Jabril and find the real assassins of Prince Abdullah. DCO is forced to pursue the investigation 'off book', ultimately leading Martin into his most dangerous stand off yet.

9.o: Martin manages to escape from an interrogation and finds out that Sonya and Aiden have been abducted. As he looks for them, he learns more information about his past.

10.o: Martin finds out that Verax could be plotting an assassination. He is also kidnapped and makes a stunning discovery about his own identity.

9.o: A threat on a summit is investigated by Martin and Nina, who search for Tamir's associate in present-day Prague. Elsewhere, two assassins spin a deadly plan into motion; Tamir's wife gives orders to Beslan; and Dmitry struggles to complete his mission.

After witnessing a murder, Thony cleans the crime scene to stay alive, then begins living a double life, cleaning for a crime syndicate while doing what is necessary to save her son.

But when her son’s health declines, she crosses a moral line, getting deeper involved with the syndicate. Meanwhile, things turn violent during a weapons exchange when inventory goes missing and Arman has 24 hours to find the thief.

Arman is tasked with collecting large "donations" for Hayak's daughter's wedding, calling into question his real role within the family. Meanwhile, a rift forms between Fiona and her son, Chris, when a secret is revealed that has major consequences for his future, sending Fiona into a spiral as she tries to find a solution.

Meanwhile, Garrett makes a risky demand of Thony, pushing her deeper into moral ambiguity.

Meanwhile, after all his efforts to secure a new business for Hayak, Arman is blindsided when Hayak chooses his daughter over him.

Then, as Luca’s health declines, Thony must decide if she can work with Mother Donna, who may be a potential resource for a liver transplant for Luca, but at what cost to Thony.

7.t: Our Father, Who Art in Vegas

8.o: Thony enlists Arman’s help to get to Mexico for Luca’s transplant, but plans go dangerously off course when Hayak finds out Arman is lying to him. Thony finds herself in a desperate situation, forcing her to call upon both the former doctor and the newfound “gangsta” in herself.

9.o: Arman's fallout with Hayak has severe consequences for Thony, who must now find her way back home from Mexico with Luca. In hiding, Arman tries to help Thony get back, but it is Garrett who steps in to get Thony across the border where, upon re-entry, things aren't what they seem.

10.o: In need of a way out, Thony tries to make a deal with Garrett to save herself and help Arman; Loyalties are put to the test as families both unite and fall apart.

1.o: Season Two picks up with Thony desperately trying to find her son, Luca, after he was kidnapped by his father Marco. With nowhere else to turn, she enlists the help of FBI Agent Garrett Miller to track him down before they leave the country. Meanwhile, an incident involving Chris forces Fiona to shield her son by any means necessary.

7.o: Detective Flores digs deeper into the cause of Marco's death. Meanwhile, Thony, Arman and Garrett team up to bring down Kamdar.

8.o: JD temporarily takes in Fiona and the kids during a time of need. Meanwhile, Garrett changes strategies in his attempt to stop Kamdar.

9.o: As Luca grows sicker, Thony will do anything to get him a new medication, including asking Kamdar for help. Meanwhile, Arman confronts Nadia about her secret.

11.o: Thony is confronted by Garrett regarding the truth behind Maya's death as Nadia tries to stay on Kamdar's good side. Meanwhile, Fiona helps Luca celebrate his birthday.

12.o: After Thony, Arman and Garrett work together to come up with a plan to take down Kamdar once and for all, Thony decides to take things into her own hands to ensure the safety of Fiona and Luca. Season finale.

11.o: As Ramona continues her attempts to recruit Thony into her business, Thony and Fiona work with the FBI to help Nadia. Meanwhile, the FBI starts organizing a plan to take down Ramona inside her own event.

Jorge’s relentless pursuit of vengeance blinds him to the truth, while Fiona, pushed to her breaking point, makes a decision that will change everything. Thony steps into the operating room — and into the fight of her life.

10.o: Thony must find a way to protect her freedom and family as she finds herself surrounded by chaos; when Jorge catches wind of Ramona's plans, he's willing to do anything to stop her; unexpected foes cause dire consequences.

11.o: A vicious prison showdown and a high-stakes escape puts everything at risk; as Fiona finds new security, a fatal decision changes her relationship with Thony forever.

1.o: The first year of Hae-yi’s Yonhee University life begins. On her first day, she runs into Jung-woo and hears about Theia. However, Theia is currently a squad that is about to go under due to a lack of members. Young-woong believes Hae-yi is the only person who can save the squad and tries to persuade her by offering what she needs most.

Therefore, Jung-woo decides to choose two freshmen to perform with the squad. Through a physical test, Hae-yi and Sun-ho get chosen. To prepare for the rally, the fiercest training awaits the two.

Meanwhile, Sun-ho asks Hae-yi out once again, but she makes it clear this time that she is not interested. She hates Jung-woo for pushing her, but she feels something about him deep inside her heart.

With that in mind, Hae-yi steps up to the stage to perform the Joint Pep Rally. But she does not know what kind of trouble awaits her on stage.

5.o: Although the joint pep rally is successful, Hae-yi could have been hurt badly if it wasn’t for Ha-jin and Sun-ho. Certain that this is not just an accident, Jung-woo digs in to find who is behind it. Theia goes on a field trip. The trip that should be filled with laughter and joy does not last that long. Someone is targeting Theia with bad intentions.

Meanwhile, Theia is put in a tough spot as more than half of the freshmen quit after the release of the horrendous video. Hae-yi is also on the verge of quitting because of Min-jae’s proposal.

He beats up another kid and is about to get sued for it. However, Sun-ho promises to help him out for something in return.

Meanwhile, Jung-woo confronts Jae-min for what he did. He comes clean with the messages he sent but denies everything else. It turns out the sabotages are not done by a single person.

However, there are many things that Jung-woo must be concerned about. The freshmen performance might not take place due to a problem with the original singer, and the culprit who almost hurt Hae-yi might strike again.

As they wake up, they find themselves in Busan. Hae-yi cannot remember anything except having a kiss with someone. Devastated, she tries to find out who it is.

11.o: The trip to Busan only makes it harder for Hae-yi to make her choice. Sun-ho kisses her and Jung-woo says he likes her. Although she tries to avoid the two guys ever since, the three groups up together for a dating assignment. After the date with each of them, she thinks deeply to find out who her heart truly desires.

12.o: Sun-ho is rejected by Hae-yi for the last time. Hae-yi and Jung-woo are now a couple but decide to keep it a secret from the others. Theia goes on a Summer Training camp. They go through passionate training and enjoy a pool party. However, an incident occurs that makes Sun-ja and Hae-yi drift away from each other.

13.o: Jin-il is the one who locked Hae-yi up and caused the fire. Thankfully, she makes it out in one piece. Jung-woo does not consider this an accident. He is certain that there is someone behind this. While Jung-woo and Cho-hee are trying to get to the bottom of this, Jin-il only makes the situation much worse.

14.o: The Hokyung University Cheering Squad visits Yonhee to prepare for the rivalry. The SBC Broadcast Station also wishes to film them and air them on TV, making the two squads more competitive. Meanwhile, Sun-ho and Jung-woo set things clear about Hae-yi. Sun-ho decides to give up on her, but will remain as her good friend.

15.o: Despite the happiness that Hae-yi is having with Jung-woo, she asks him to break up with her. It is because Chun-yang is diagnosed with breast cancer. In order to earn money for surgery, Hae-yi must work more jobs and cannot make time for Jung-woo. However, Jung-woo does not give up on her and neither does her friends on the cheering squad.

16.o: Jung-woo finds Hae-yi in time and saves her from life-threatening danger. Although he gets hospitalized for getting stabbed, he is just happy that Hae-yi is safe. After Jung-woo’s recovery, Theia focuses back on preparing for the Yonhee-Hokyung Rivalry. Despite all the troubles and hardships everyone goes through, they will always have each other to rely on.

1.o: Separate episodes revolve around divorce and family problems within a social framework, and at the end of each story, coincidence brings together the characters of the story ending in the new story.

Ko You and Ko Jun-hee are besties at Hara High School. Although they have the same surname and are both handsome, they are different in everything else. Their school life changes as a pretty transfer student comes to Hara High. They fall in love with So-yeon instantly and the love triangle between the three begins.

2.o: The three musketeers go on a journey to find a store where they can buy alcohol. Strangely, they keep running into So-yeon, the new girl, outside the school, and it bothers both You and Jun-hee. Meanwhile, Jun-hee's dizziness gets worse each day, and You tries to get closer to So-yeon.

3.o: Joon-hee is taken to the hospital after he gets beaten up. However, something other than his wounds is found. It turns out he is going through chronic renal failure just like his brother Joon-young. But this time, he has someone looking out for him. Despite Eun-hye's disagreement, Go Yoo firmly decides to donate his kidney to Joon-hee.

4.t: Liking Someone With All Your Might
4.o: Go Yoo and So-yeon hang out more often and start to show their feelings for each other. Therefore, Joon-hee feels disappointed and left out. On Sunday night, Go Yoo and his friends are having a secret wine party at school, and he invites So-yeon to join them.

5.t: A Secret That Only You Didn't Know
5.o: Subtle air flows between Yoo and Joon-hee due to their feelings for So-yeon. Meanwhile, Joon-hee becomes more confused about the changes happening to his body and mind. Later, Yoo discovers the secret So-yeon has been hiding.

6.t: Sadness Brings Forth a Strong Will
6.o: Go Yoo takes a look at So-yeon's bag and finds Grandma Mo's necklace she lost. He immediately gets disappointed in her, but she does not give any explanation. Meanwhile, Joon-hee tries to think, talk, and act like Go Yoo.

7.t: If We Don't Let Go of Our Hands Even When We Are in Conflict
7.o: Ever since the transplant, Joon-hee has been acting strangely. He has become more violent and started to act differently. Also, although he says he is looking out for So-yeon as a friend, he is being overprotective. Frustrated by Joon-hee's actions, Yoo aggressively tries to make him come back to his senses.

8.o: Yoo and Joon-hee have a huge fight in front of the whole school and end up in the teacher's office. Meanwhile, Joon-hee's grandmother collapses and gets an emergency operation.

1.t: The Other One and the Last One
1.o: Sajo Hyeon, the crown prince with two personalities in one body, meets a woman in a clothing shop. That woman is the only survivor of the Yeon clan, which was wiped out 10 years ago. In order to take revenge, Yeon Wol infiltrated the palace and eventually aimed the tip of her knife at the king

2.o: Ak-hee's clever maneuver results in Yeon Wol losing all her memories, placing her on the brink of becoming the Crown Prince's concubine. However, her innate instincts drive her to break free and discover her true identity and rightful place. While wandering beyond the palace confines, she crosses paths with Sajo Hyeon and, with hesitation, chooses to return to the palace, unknowingly stepping into a web of schemes set to engulf her.

3.o: With Sajo Hyeon's quick thinking, Yeon Wol manages to narrowly escape the life-threatening scheme. Overwhelmed with gratitude, Yeon Wol tries to express her thanks, unknowingly reopening deep scars for Sajo Hyeon. Sensing vulnerability, Ak-hee seizes the moment to assert control over Sajo Hyeon's body, eventually aiming to lock him up permanently.

4.o: Yeon Wol, having regained her memories, prepares for the long-awaited revenge she has devoted her life to. Meanwhile, a clever move by Chung Ta allows Sajo Hyeon to avoid the binding ritual. Gradually, Sajo Hyeon finds comfort in Yeon Wol and starts to open up to her. A rumor swiftly spreads throughout the palace about Yeon Wol's true identity.

5.o: Following the enigmatic demise of Sajo Seung, Yeon Wol, wrongly labeled as the assailant, harbors suspicions that Sajo Yoong is the true mastermind behind Sajo Seung's death. Meanwhile, Sajo Hyeon finds himself unable to shake off the thoughts of Yeon Wol, who implored him to believe in her innocence. In the end, Hyeon opts to enter into a precarious arrangement with Ak Hee in a bid to rescue Yeon Wol.

In 1919, northern warlord Cheng Jun sets his sights on the presidency and courts military backing from Sujing's three cities. Hoping to secure his own future, Yu Zhongquan, who controls Nanhuai, decides to join forces with Cheng's close ally, Chu Wenfu, and support Cheng's bid.
